name: Cornerless Terminal Edge-Product Obstruction of Order 865
definition: Take the fixed certified $289$-concept family $A\subseteq Q_{12}$ with unique corner $0$ and marked edge $D=\{0,2\}$, and use a disjoint-coordinate copy of the same rooted factor as $(R,0)$. Form $X=P_R(A,D)=(A\times\{0\})\cup(D\times R)$.
properties: $X$ is ample, cornerless, and a forbidden pc-minor for dismantlable ampleness. Every nonempty coordinate reduction is dismantlable ample and the minimum degree is four. The marked presentation is isomorphic, by the recorded bit permutation and reflection, to the previously known cornerless proper halfspace of the $1601$-concept square-code control.
